title: 1RB1LD_0RC0RF_1LC0LA_0LE1LD_1LA---_0RB0LF: the event map, and where it halts
text: The run of 1RB1LD_0RC0RF_1LC0LA_0LE1LD_1LA---_0RB0LF is now an explicit map on lists of block lengths: at each left-end visit the first block is divided by 3, remainder 1 passes two thirds on and deals the next block too, remainders 0 and 2 end the visit. The map reproduces all 2,406 events of the first 3·10^9 steps and 118,645 test lists (checked, not proved). The machine halts when two small blocks meet at the left end, for instance 4 then 3. In 8·10^9 events the run never gets there, but near misses come at a steady rate per doubling of the run, so a halt far beyond any run looks more likely than not.
